decisions.reason: Existence and acetyl site supported by NMR, but the cited diagnostic fragments are EI-MS. Do not transfer them into native ESI gates or reinterpret long O-acyl as acetyl.
Primary work defines 1-O-acyl omega-linoleoyloxy ceramides with long acyls; it does not validate the literal acetyl name and formulas in the historical list.

Saturated 3-ketodihydroceramides (NdK) have experimental evidence including the C18 m/z 270 channel. Do not apply this to the unresolved old keto-Cer grid or its unsaturated forms without a separate composition/site review.

Correct missing NeuAc in the independent reference catalog. Composition matches the GM1 elemental family, but shared Y/B products do not establish lacto/neolacto/ganglio linkage; no direct GM1 alias is enabled.

decisions.mass_correction: Formula atomic mass minus electron mass, not plus proton
decisions.reason: Intrinsic monocation and the native trimethylaminium product are verified. A common m/z 60 head alone is insufficient for a conservative independent sphingoid-backbone gate.

decisions.mass_basis: Elemental assignments inferred from three-decimal published masses, including ionic electron correction; theoretical equal library intensities, not measured intensities
decisions.reporting: Single-base composition; no FA chain upgrade, double-bond position or stereochemical assignment
decisions.scope: Only the experimentally documented d18:1 composition; no methylated-base homolog grid

decisions.reason: No suitable native positive standard spectrum with a verified N-monomethyl-specific gate was established in this review. Do not infer N-methylation from precursor formula and shared dehydration alone.
Do not confuse unsaturated 3-ketosphingosine with saturated 3-ketosphinganine, or prediction/derivatization spectra with native positive CID. No unsaturated ketoSo gate is enabled.
